description: This Java source file implements the ProductOptionValueDao interface, providing database access methods related to ProductOptionValue entities within a Spring application context. It contains methods for retrieving product option values by store, ID, name, and code, utilizing QueryDSL for building JPQL queries.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access object for ProductOptionValue, providing methods to query product option values from the database based on various criteria.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues for a given store and language, fetching related descriptions and store data, ordered by ID.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves a list of non-read-only ProductOptionValues for a specified store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOptionValue by its ID for a specific store.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Searches for ProductOptionValues in a store matching a name pattern and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOptionValue by its code within a specific store.
